# Project listing

Use the gear icon beside **About** on the repository home page and enter the following fields.

- **Description (English):** Transfer files from your phone to your computer over a local network with QR codes and desktop approval.
- **Description (Vietnamese alternative):** Gửi tệp từ điện thoại đến máy tính qua mạng nội bộ bằng mã QR, có xác nhận trên máy tính.
- **Website:** https://github.com/truongminhkhanng/QRDrop/releases/latest
- **Topics:** `file-transfer`, `local-network`, `qr-code`, `tauri`, `react`, `rust`, `windows`, `macos`, `linux`
- **Visibility:** Public. Open Settings → General → Danger Zone → Change repository visibility → Change to public.

The repository has one description field. Use the English description above; both documentation languages are linked from the README.
